figures.cap: triangle North Haven, South Haven, West Haven (NOT TO SCALE)

solutions.latex:
The angle at South Haven is $115^\circ$.

Using the cosine rule in the triangle, with $d$ the distance from West Haven to North Haven:
$$\begin{aligned} d^2 &= 7.5^2 + 4.2^2 - 2\times 7.5\times 4.2\times\cos 115^\circ \\ &= 100.514\ldots \end{aligned}$$
$$\begin{aligned} d &= 10.025\ldots \\ &\approx 10 \text{ km} \end{aligned}$$
criteria: Correct cosine rule substitution, or equivalent merit

figures.cap: triangle TVU with TV = 7.5 m, VU = 4.8 m, TU = 10.4 m

solutions.latex:
Using the cosine rule with the angle $\angle TVU$ opposite side $TU$:
$$\cos C = \dfrac{a^2 + b^2 - c^2}{2ab}$$
$$\begin{aligned} \cos \angle TVU &= \dfrac{4.8^2 + 7.5^2 - 10.4^2}{2 \times 4.8 \times 7.5} \\ &= -0.4009\ldots \\ \angle TVU &= 113^\circ 38' \end{aligned}$$
$$\therefore\ \angle TVU \approx 114^\circ \text{ (nearest degree)}$$
criteria: Substitutes correctly into the cosine rule, or equivalent merit
